en:
Passpine 0.1.4

• Official builds now check for updates automatically and download them by default. Turning off automatic downloads keeps background checks enabled.
• Updates prefer smaller file-level packages and fall back to the full package if an incremental download or verification fails.
• Settings show the current version, release notes, download progress and retry actions. Installation waits for your confirmation to restart and for current operations to finish.
• Signed update metadata, package hashes and file manifests are verified before installation. Failed installation or startup restores the previous application without migrating vault data.
• Local make build and make install produce Passpine Dev with separate application, data and browser identities. Official releases are built and signed by GitHub Actions.

Older installations without an embedded update verification key require one manual installation of this official release to enable future updates.
zh-CN:
Passpine 0.1.4

• 正式版自动检查更新，默认自动下载；关闭自动下载后仍在后台检查。
• 优先使用较小的文件级增量包，增量下载或校验失败时自动回退完整包。
• 设置页展示当前版本、更新说明、下载进度与失败重试；安装需确认重启，并等待当前操作结束。
• 安装前验证签名更新元数据、包哈希和目标文件清单；安装或启动失败时恢复原应用，安装流程不迁移密码库数据。
• 本地 make build 和 make install 生成 Passpine Dev，应用、数据和浏览器身份与正式版分开；正式版由 GitHub Actions 构建并签署更新制品。

未嵌入更新验证公钥的旧安装，需要手动安装一次本正式版，才能接收后续自动更新。
